verdicts.reason: A is basically the original lifted onto the square canvas: centred and faithful, but the gap between headline and CTA is too big and the bottom third is dead space. B squeezes the headline into a 4-line column on the left and leaves the right half completely empty, which looks lopsided. Its CTA has shrunk, and the LIMITED badge dangles under the button slightly off-axis.

A is a faithful centred layout, though the headline-to-CTA gap is loose and the lower half is empty. B pushes everything into the top-right, leaving the left and bottom empty. Its LIMITED badge is now bigger and heavier than the 'See the Flavours' CTA, so the hierarchy is upside down, and the button text is small.

A breaks the group apart. The badge floats alone mid-canvas and the CTA is shrunk to an unreadable pill jammed into the bottom-right corner, so the call to action is buried. B is the faithful centred version: badge and CTA stay together, with only the loose vertical spacing and empty lower third as flaws.
